people.name: Antioch
people.line: A city in Pisidia where Paul preached the gospel.

people.name: Iconium
people.line: A city in Asia Minor visited by Paul

people.name: Lystra
people.line: A city in Lycaonia; Paul and Barnabas preached there

translations.web: persecutions, and sufferings: those things that happened to me at Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. I endured those persecutions. The Lord delivered me out of them all.
translations.bsb: my persecutions, and the sufferings that came upon me in Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. What persecutions I endured! Yet the Lord rescued me from all of them.
translations.kjv: Persecutions, afflictions, which came unto me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured: but out of them all the Lord delivered me.
translations.asv: persecutions, sufferings. What things befell me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured. And out of them all the Lord delivered me.
